transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because my family and friends made me. They keep showing me these bank papers and saying they prove nothing was taken from me. But I know what's going on. For over a year now, I’ve known they’re hiding my money. They use things like regular bills, or fundraisers, and planning trips just to cover it all up. So I just
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is there?

No. I don't hear voices or anything like that. I mean... I just hear regular people talking when they're actually in the room with me. I'm not making things up in my head, if that's what you mean. I just know what they're doing.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, not really. I mean... I sleep pretty normal. I don't have times where I'm just full of energy and not sleeping, if that's what you're asking. I just get my regular sleep.
For how long have you believed that people are hiding your money?
It's been going on since my income dropped. So... about a year and two months ago, I'd say. That's when I realized what they were doing.
Over the past year, have you found yourself caring much less about things or having a lot less motivation to do everyday activities?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still care about things... I still get up and do what I need to do every day. I haven't lost my motivation or anything. I just... I just want to figure out where my money is going. That's what I'm focused on. But I still do my regular everyday stuff.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem mixed up?

No, nobody's ever said that to me. I speak plain enough. I know what I'm saying and people understand me just fine. My thoughts aren't mixed up at all... I'm actually thinking very clearly about all this.
Since this started, has your ability to work gotten a lot worse?
Well, I don't actually have a job right now. I haven't been working anyway, so... no, I can't really say it's gotten worse. I just don't work.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I haven't seen anything like that. I just see what's really there, same as anyone else. I'm not seeing things that aren't real.
Have people told you that you seem much less expressive or show less emotion than you used to?
No, nobody's mentioned anything like that. I feel like I show my feelings the same as I always have. I haven't noticed any change, and no one else has brought it up to me.
Do you believe anyone can control your thoughts?
No... no, nobody controls my thoughts. They're just my own. I don't really know how anyone could even do that, so... no, that's not happening to me.
Do you believe the way your money is being taken involves something physically impossible, like special powers or technology that ordinary people couldn’t use?

No, it's nothing like that. It's not magic or special powers or anything crazy. They're just... stealing from me the normal way, I guess. I mean, they just take it. It's not some impossible technology, it's just them taking what's mine.
